text: Yesterday around 5:30pm I was stopped at the light on Elm Ave and Pine St when another car rear-ended me. We exchanged insurance info. Nobody was hurt and my car still drives, but the rear bumper and trunk are dented.
This morning I slid on ice on Route 9 near the river bridge and hit the guardrail. No one else was involved and I'm okay. The front bumper is cracked and the guardrail is bent.
Yesterday around 6pm I was stopped at a red light on Main St when a pickup hit me from behind and drove off. My bumper is crushed and my neck is sore.
My car was stolen from my driveway overnight, sometime between 11pm and 6am on Tuesday. I live in Maple Heights. I filed a police report this morning and have the report number.
Someone stole my car from the Walmart parking lot on Grand Blvd last night around 9pm. I haven't called the police yet.
Someone broke my window and stole my catalytic converter and the stereo while I was parked at the gym on 3rd St last night.
Sometime Monday night someone keyed the whole driver side of my car and slashed a tire while it was parked in the garage at my apartment on Lakeview Dr. I didn't call the police.
Kids spray-painted my hood and smashed my side mirrors on purpose while the car was parked on the street on Halloween night.
The hail storm on Tuesday afternoon dented my roof and hood pretty badly. The car was parked at home in Cedar Falls. The windshield is fine.
During the storm last night a big tree branch fell on my car in the driveway and caved in the roof.
The river flooded our street on Sunday and water came up over the doors of my car. It won't start now.
My engine caught fire while I was driving on Highway 30 this afternoon. I pulled over and the fire department put it out. Nobody was hurt but the car had to be towed and won't start.
A fire in my neighbor's garage spread to my carport overnight and my car's paint and interior are burned.
A rock kicked up by a truck hit my windshield on I-80 near exit 42 yesterday morning. The crack is about 8 inches and spreading.
My rear window shattered on its own while the car was parked at work today. Nothing else is damaged.
I hit a deer on County Road 12 last night around 10pm. The grille and headlight are smashed but I was able to drive home. I'm fine.
A moose ran into the side of my car on Route 1 early this morning and dented both doors.
Something happened to my car and I need help.
My car is damaged. Please call me back.
Last month hail cracked my sunroof at home, and today someone dented my door in the gym parking lot on 3rd St.
Two things: my catalytic converter was stolen last week at work, and yesterday I rear-ended someone on Oak Ave.
